quality.intervalPolicy: Published exhibition run retained once, without daily expansion; date interval is not a claim of continuous opening. Opening is a separate explicitly timed occurrence.
quality.englishCompanions: Every event/place has titleEn, venueEn, addressEn, descriptionEn, admissionEn and sourceEn; sources have nameEn. Unknown values remain null.
quality.countsMeaning: Occurrences are not distinct productions. Sixteen Paradox workshop sessions belong to one series; two Stage festival dates belong to one series. No quota-based completion claim.
quality.municipalityRule: Strict Limassol municipality; outside-district venues excluded or pending.
quality.endTimePolicy: Only explicit source end times; never duration arithmetic.
quality.boundaryValidation: Editorial venue evidence, not authoritative GIS
